name: Lesser Mysteries
summary: The spring myesis at Agrai by the Ilissus — purification and teaching that opened the road to the Greater Mysteries, focused on Kore's return, and in myth the rites Heracles needed before facing Persephone below.
testimonia: Pausanias 1.19.6 (Agrae and Artemis Agrotera across the Ilissus)
Scholia to Aristophanes, Plutus 845 (the Lesser Mysteries at Agrai)
